items.statement: Do not use gradient fills as a primary visual device (no multi-stop linear-gradient decoration).
Do not use purple or indigo accent defaults.
Do not use emoji as icons, bullets, or nav items.
Do not use identical repeated card grids with an icon-over-heading skeleton.
Do not use pill-spam badge rows.
Do not use glassmorphism or backdrop-blur chrome.
Do not use terminal mockups with three traffic-light dots.
Do not use centered-marketing hero grammar inside operator tooling.
Do not use pure #fff/#000 text pairs.
Do not use decorative charts or sparklines that present no real data.
Do not write instructional essays in empty states.
